blocks.tamil_translation: Rasulullah ﷺ raised his head from sajdah and made du'a: “Peace be upon the Hamdan tribe! Peace be upon the Hamdan tribe!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ خُرَيْمِ بْنِ فَاتِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ أَنْفَقَ نَفَقَةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ سَبْعُمِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن، باب ما جاء في فضل النفقة في سبيل الله، رقم:١٦٢٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Khuraim ibn Fatik (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever spends something in the path of Allah Ta'ala, it is written in his record seven hundred times over.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ وَالصَِّيَامَ وَالذِّكْرَ يُضَاعَفُ عَلَي النَّفَقَةِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ بِسَبْعِ مِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد، باب في تضعيف الذكر في سبيل الله ، رقم: ٢٤٩٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mu'adh (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Indeed, the reward of performing Salah, fasting and making Dhikr in the path of Allah Ta'ala is multiplied seven hundred times over the reward obtained for spending wealth in the path of Allah Ta'ala.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذٍ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ الذِّكْرَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ يُضَعَّفُ فَوْقَ النَّفَقَةِ بِسَبْعِ مِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: قَالَ يَحْي فِي حَدِيثِهِ: بِسَبْعِمِائَةِ اَلْفِ ضِعْفٍ. رواه احمد:٣ /٤٣٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mu'adh (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Indeed, the reward of making Dhikr in the path of Allah Ta'ala is multiplied seven hundred times over the reward obtained for spending (in the path of Allah Ta'ala).” In another narration, “the reward is multiplied seven hundred thousand times
